spp-gi-active.how: Read the Southwest Power Pool active generator list at https://opsportal.spp.org/Studies/GIActive and went through every Kansas row (184 of 1,018 rows) for gas, oil and thermal requests.
spp-gi-active.found: Labette GEN-2024-129 (910 MW, added as a new plant), Quindaro ERAS-2025-031 (150 MW diesel, added as a unit), McPherson ASGI-2024-020 (123.73 MW, added as a unit), Leavenworth GEN-2024-253 (300 MW thermal and storage, watch list), Jeffrey GEN-2024-249 (721 MW, question for the reviewer), Sherlock ERAS-2025-017 (same as Sherlock, question), Clifton GEN-2026-GR1 (97.8 MW, question), Riverton GEN-2024-GR4 (27 MW, watch list), Walnut GEN-2020-003 (already in GEM). Viola and McNew are already in GEM.

spp-eras.how: Read the generator interconnection page at https://www.spp.org/engineering/generator-interconnection/ and the expedited resource adequacy study rows on the active list.
spp-eras.found: Four Kansas expedited requests: Sherlock ERAS-2025-017 (same as the Sherlock plant in GEM), Quindaro ERAS-2025-031 (added as a unit), and Viola ERAS-2025-008 and McNew ERAS-2025-006 (both already in GEM).

kdhe-air-notices.how: Read the state health department public notice pages and the saved copies of the Crooked Creek notice, draft permit, summary and application. Read the Sherlock draft permit at https://www.kdhe.ks.gov/DocumentCenter/View/60493.
kdhe-air-notices.found: Crooked Creek and Sherlock are the only gas power plant permits open. Both are already in GEM. Two questions on Crooked Creek (point and start year) are in the question list. No other power plant notice found.

kansas-register.how: Read the Kansas Register notice of April 23, 2026 at https://sos.ks.gov/publications/register/Volume-45/Issues/Issue-17/04-23-26-54081.html and searched recent issues for power plant, generating and air quality notices.
kansas-register.found: The Crooked Creek notice, already in GEM. No other generation notice found.

kcc-dockets.how: The old filing site timed out, so I read the commission's new filing site, KCC-Connect, through a real browser. Searched for Evergy, Sunflower, McPherson, Quindaro, Sherlock, Crooked Creek and Clifton dockets and read the application in docket 27-EKCE-0149-PRE.
kcc-dockets.found: Docket 27-EKCE-0149-PRE of September 1, 2026 covers Buchanan Bluffs in Missouri plus solar and storage in Kansas, no Kansas gas plant. Also 25-EKCE-207-PRE (Viola, McNew, already in GEM), 27-SEPE-0138-STG and 26-EKCE-0148-STG (transmission), 27-SEPE-0077-CON (a contract docket). Nothing generation related for Quindaro, Sherlock, Crooked Creek or Clifton.

eia-860m.how: Read the August 2026 monthly generator table (august_generator2026.xlsx) for Kansas planned, canceled and operating gas units.
eia-860m.found: Planned gas: Viola, McNew and two 13.5 MW Riverton units. Canceled: Osawatomie units 2 to 8 and Nearman Creek 5. Every operating gas plant over 50 MW is in GEM.

eia-860.how: Read the Proposed sheet of the 2024 annual generator table (eia8602024.zip) for Kansas gas units.
eia-860.found: Riverton 13 and 14 (13.5 MW each), Viola 765 MW combined cycle (2029) and McNew 765 MW combined cycle (2030). No other gas.

evergy-irp.how: Read Evergy's 2025 and 2026 plan updates at https://investors.evergy.com/2025IRPUpdate and https://investors.evergy.com/2026IRPUpdate and the Missouri commission filings.
evergy-irp.found: Kansas Central gas: 355 MW 2029 (Viola), 355 MW 2030 (McNew) and 710 MW 2031 (Buchanan Bluffs Unit 1, Missouri, on the watch list). Evergy Metro 440 MW 2031 is Mullin Creek 2, already in GEM under Missouri. 355 MW in 2032 is half of Buchanan Unit 2, Missouri. No new Kansas gas plant.

evergy-news.how: Read the Evergy newsroom list at https://newsroom.evergy.com/ for 2026 items.
evergy-news.found: The May 12, 2026 item on construction in Sumner County is Viola, already in GEM. Nothing new.

sunflower.how: Read https://sunflower.net/generation and https://sunflower.net/news and the Clifton replacement fact sheet.
sunflower.found: Nine gas facilities of 1,095 MW. The Clifton replacement is already in GEM as unit 2 (question on unit structure added). Sherlock is linked to Sunflower. No other new gas.

midwest-energy.how: Read https://www.mwenergy.com/news and the generation pages.
midwest-energy.found: No new generation. A July 14, 2026 maintenance deal for the existing 104 MW Goodman Energy Center.

kansas-power-pool.how: The Kansas Power Pool site is at https://www.kpp.energy/ (the older kansaspowerpool.org address is dead). The site loads, and its Lightning Round newsletters were read during the Walnut Energy Center research. The Southwest Power Pool list and the EIA tables were checked for its plants as well.
kansas-power-pool.found: Nothing new. Walnut Energy Center is in GEM and matches Southwest Power Pool request GEN-2020-003.

kmea.how: Read https://kmea.com/ and its news items.
kmea.found: Only September 2026 items on the homepage, no new generation. The news page address returns an error.

bpu.how: Read the Kansas City Board of Public Utilities 2024 resource plan in full from the live copy and from a saved copy, and the Southwest Power Pool Quindaro and McPherson rows.
bpu.found: Plan commits to no gas. Quindaro oil turbines retire early in one study case. A 237 MW simple cycle turbine for 2039 is an option in another study case (watch list). Southwest Power Pool shows a 150 MW diesel request at Quindaro (added as a unit) and a McPherson 123.73 MW request (added as a unit).

liberty-empire.how: Read the Missouri commission filings for case EA-2023-0131 at https://efis.psc.mo.gov/Document/Display/768252 and https://efis.psc.mo.gov/Document/Display/773603 and searched for Liberty Kansas generation filings.
liberty-empire.found: Riverton replacement of two 13.3 MW turbines (watch list, under the bar). Liberty's 240 to 250 MW Stateline plant is in Missouri.

eip-oil-gas-watch.how: Read https://oilandgaswatch.org/ and used the match results in work/ids_us-kansas.md for Kansas facilities.
eip-oil-gas-watch.found: No Kansas gas plant that is missing from GEM. The Crooked Creek facility is already in GEM.

possible-updates-sheet.how: I did not open the possible updates sheet. The Kansas country note records that the sheet had no open Kansas rows on October 21, 2026.
possible-updates-sheet.found: No open Kansas rows per that note.

captive-lng-sheet.how: I did not open the captive LNG workbook. I read the saved result of the captive_lng.py run, work/captive_us-kansas.json.
captive-lng-sheet.found: No Kansas LNG terminals, so no captive LNG plants.

data-centers.how: Searched the web and trade press for Kansas data center campuses with on-site gas generation, and checked Southwest Power Pool rows tied to data centers.
data-centers.found: Flint Hills Digital Campus in Emporia, which plans some on-site generation with no unit named (watch list). Beale Infrastructure and Digital Realty have only grid service agreements with Evergy. Sherlock is a data center plant already in GEM. An offer to buy the closed Quindaro site is not generation.
